Acquisition is DDA based on the '15 most intense precursors' selection logic. While the results discuss histones and neutrophil extracellular traps, no specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or ubiquitylome) was performed; the study is a global proteome analysis following depletion of abundant proteins.
